title: [Hinglish - Instagram/YouTube only] Skill tab likho, har baar paste mat karo
content:
Har baar wahi instructions paste kar rahe ho?

Claude Code mein us paste ka naam skill hai.
1 folder. Andar 1 file. Naam SKILL.md.
Usme kaam likho, aur yeh bhi likho
ki Claude ko wo file kab kholni hai.

A skill is not a longer CLAUDE.md.
Claude Code docs yeh kehte hain.
CLAUDE.md har session mein load hoti hai.
Skill ka body tab load hota hai
jab wo skill use hoti hai.

The long checklist stays OUT of the window
until you actually call it.

Ab file kahan rakho, yeh decide karo.

Personal skill ka path hai
home folder, .claude, skills,
phir skill ka naam, phir SKILL.md.
Ye is machine ke projects mein aati hai.
Cowork aur cloud sessions mein nahi.

Personal skills stay on this computer.
They do not follow you into Cowork
or a cloud session.

Project skill ka path hai
repo ke andar .claude/skills.
Us file ko commit karo,
taaki team ko wahi skill mile.

Commit the project skill
if the team should share it.

You can also type the command.
Folder ka naam, ya frontmatter ka name,
wohi slash command ban jaata hai.
Claude khud bhi skill utha sakta hai
jab description match kare.

A clear description is what makes
that automatic pick work.

Yahan 2 official pages
same sentence nahi kehte.

Anthropic ke GitHub repo
anthropics/skills ki README kehti hai
frontmatter mein name aur description likho.
Claude Code ki apni skills docs kehti hain
saare frontmatter fields optional hain,
aur description recommend kiya gaya hai.

Read both pages before you copy the template.
The template and the product docs
do not match word for word.

The repo is a demo, not a promise.
README kehti hai ye skills
demonstration ke liye hain.
Claude ka behaviour in files se
alag ho sakta hai.
Kai skills Apache 2.0 hain.
Pages, slides, aur spreadsheets
wali document skills source-available hain.
Open source nahi.

The README draws that license split itself.
Test the skill on your own files
before you trust it on a real repo.

Install bhi README ke hisaab se hai.
Claude Code mein type karo
slash plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills.
Phir slash plugin install
example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Document wala pack alag command hai,
document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.

Install the pack by the full name
printed in the README.
Then say the skill name in the prompt.
README ka example yeh hai.
Document skill se form fields nikaalo.
Random zip mat daalo.

Say you paste the same review every week.
Assumptions likho.
Sirf maanga hua code chhedo.
Tests chalao, phir done bolo.
Us paste ko 1 skill bana do.
Description mein likho
yeh review kab chahiye.

Turn that repeated paste into 1 skill.
Next time, use the slash command,
or let the description pull it in.

Agar skill nahi uthi,
description ko aur specific banao.
Cute naam se skill trigger nahi hoti.

If it never fires, rewrite the description.
A cute name does not trigger it.

Mera take simple hai.
Jo baat har session mein chahiye,
wo CLAUDE.md mein rakho.
Jo procedure kabhi kabhi chahiye,
wo SKILL.md mein rakho.
1 paste jo baar baar hota hai,
usko skill banao, chat mein mat chhodo.

Keep facts in CLAUDE.md.
Keep the procedure in the skill.

Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
